fichas.title: Railway platforms: widths, clearances, heights, lengths, and roofing
fichas.summary: Guidance for sizing side and central railway platforms according to passenger numbers, walking-route width, and safety zones determined by train speed. The page gives platform clearance relationships, minimum widths, platform heights and length classifications, and roofing clearances. Danger-area expressions are printed as subtractions; no calculated results are supplied for those expressions.
